versions.changelog:
Initial release of tia-cicd-diff skill.

- Integrates Siemens TIA Portal Openness API for diffing .zap18 project files.
- Supports extraction and comparison of code and hardware changes between two projects.
- Provides both machine-readable (JSON) and human-readable (Markdown) summaries of differences.
- Utilizes external scripts and a working directory for file handling and processing.
